The '''Ethics Committee''' was a committee of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. It investigated [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] during his last few months in office.
